channel.title: Flagship blog
channel.description: Field notes from a personal-cloud project that takes self-hosting seriously.

item.title: What's new in Flagship 0.4
item.description: People can call you from your voi.ci page, apps get direct addresses that skip our relay, and plans are paid with vouchers that never name your account. Free stays free.

item.title: What's new in Flagship 0.3
item.description: Your phone checks every new server is yours, AI runs on your own server, apps get their own databases, and the server software was rebuilt for security. Still free.
